summary: Removed MonitoringSystem -> generates -> Alert inverse duplicate
reason: The model profile allows one directed relationship per real-world connection. The action needs Alert -> MonitoringSystem reachability for acknowledgement, but no competency question or action requires starting from a MonitoringSystem to list generated alerts.
agentImpact: The graph is less contradictory while still supporting alert acknowledgement and alert-source lookup.
before: Both Alert -> originatedFrom -> MonitoringSystem and MonitoringSystem -> generates -> Alert were modeled for the same source connection.
evidence: "Acknowledge an incoming alert from the monitoring system" and "Alert → originated from → Monitoring System ... crucial for alert acknowledgment."

summary: Removed unreachable incident condition from canGeneratePostIncidentReview
reason: The action input is PostIncidentReview, but the graph only links Incident -> hasReview -> PostIncidentReview. From a PostIncidentReview input, the agent cannot reach Incident because there is no reverse edge. The rule had referred to Incident status and Incident having a review record.
agentImpact: The generatePostIncidentReviewReport action now depends only on information reachable from its input class.
before: canGeneratePostIncidentReview required Incident status is resolved or closed and Incident has a Post-Incident Review record.
after: canGeneratePostIncidentReview keeps only Post-Incident Review status is draft or in review.
evidence: "generatePostIncidentReviewReport — Input class: PostIncidentReview" and relationship confirmed only as "Incident → has review → Post-Incident Review".
